independentSourceInventory.sourceFact: Thick horseshoe permanent magnet: joined curved return at upper right/back, farther pale S face and nearer dark N face at the open end.
Five separate two-ended suspended needles at upper far left, upper middle left, lower left, central gap, and lower right. Five suspension strands, no supporting frame.

Needle two-tone end arrangement is position-dependent. Upper far-left dark end is screen-right, lower-left dark end is toward upper right, lower-right dark end is toward lower right, and the central-gap dark end is toward upper left.
The upper-middle-left blade runs lower-left to upper-right in the opened source, with its darker end toward lower left.
No current arrows, field-line curves, needle N/S letters, Earth, ground line, coordinate axes or numerical angles are present.
